newsitem.title: FRANCE: Frenchwoman looks to sky for compensation.
newsitem.headline: Frenchwoman looks to sky for compensation.

text.p: A Frenchwoman is keeping a chunk of ice that fell out of the sky in her freezer, hoping to trace its owner and get him to fix the roof of her home.
Claudine Cornille told France 2 television on Friday the 30-cm-long (12 in) block of ice cut a gaping hole in the roof.
"It fell from the sky, apparently from a plane," she said.

She was suing for damages and hoped the airline could be traced through an analysis of the ice. Her home, in the northern Paris suburb of Pontoise, is on the path of planes flying in and out of Roissy airport.
